title: Traceroute (Trace)
description: Traceroute shows the exact path a piece of data takes to get from your computer to the target website. It lists every 'hop' (usually a router) along the way and how long the data spent getting there.
tips: If the trace stops halfway or shows stars (*), a router might be blocking traffic or is offline.
High latency at a specific hop often pinpoints where the network bottleneck is.
